issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): dead private __getattr__ in query_profile profiles __init__

task_type_fields.impact: Blocks just check (and sase tool run check) from going green for any agent working in this checkout.
task_type_fields.repro: Run just _lint-symvision on a clean tree; it reports 'Private functions/classes must be used in the file where they are defined: __getattr__ in src/sase/ace/query_profile/profiles/__init__.py'. Reproduced on the untouched base via git stash, so it is not caused by current work.

issue.creation_reason: Found while verifying the adaptive update-failure dialog; symvision fails identically on the untouched base tree, so it is pre-existing and blocks just check green.

payload.entry: Verified fixed on master 2c9f761210: the lazy __getattr__ export came from sase-1jm.2.1.4 (18f53d3e57, profile-token) and 8fdf12a8a8 (sase-1jc.8) added __dir__ plus the _PEP562_HOOKS tuple; just _lint-symvision no longer reports src/sase/ace/query_profile/profiles/__init__.py. Closed by the sase-1jm.2.1 land agent.
